title: Enterprise Connectivity: activation fee
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following activation fee for each named contract tier. One-time fee for a newly activated holding; USD decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | activation fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | activation fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | activation fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | activation fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | activation fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | activation fee | 0 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the activation fee is 0.
